20000.long_desc: Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 is our most advanced joystick arcade machine to date. Built for dedicated gamers, the Xtreme 3.0 is an industry-leading step forward in arcade gaming for both home and commercial use. This machine creates a true arcade experience with 1ms HD gaming monitor, Sanwa joystick and buttons, 2.1 audio sound system with subwoofer, Jamma, JVS arcade and full console/PC support. What makes Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 so great and versatile is that you can keep updating your machine with free firmware updates (to update to current consoles/hardware if supported) as well as adding various add-ons and panel changes. This is a dynamic machine, it will be as “fresh” and modern as the day you purchased. Our older Version 1.0 and 2.0 Xtreme customers can simply buy the latest panels and upgrade their machines to current series. Play with friends around the world, record your sessions and stream with full media support for Youtube, Twitch, Discord, Skype and more. Firmware updates are constantly being released to support the latest consoles and software and drive enhanced performance. Register your Arcooda machine online to join the owner's community for benefits such as set up videos, firmware updates, special downloads, exclusive discounts, technical support and the owners forum. Make your Xtreme 3.0 unique with Arcooda's product builder. Customise button layouts, colour schemes, hardware and more. Key features on the Xtreme 3.0 arcade machine include; MONITOR: supports 15khz, 31khz, and up to 1080P HD inputs via VGA and HDMI inputs. This monitor has been designed for arcade gamers featuring 1.3ms response time at 1080P. Monitor adjustments are at the front of the machine for easy handling. SOUND: with 2.1 audio sound system, this custom sound package was designed for arcade, including subwoofer. Adjust the sound via volume control and separate subwoofer volume control. CONTROLS: Xtreme 3.0 arcade machine features Japanese made joystick and buttons. Sanwa are the world's premium arcade controllers offering years of trouble free operation. CABINET: Up to 2mm powdercoated steel construction, with acrylic panels. Internally, the machine is layered allowing you to update your machine at any time with the Arcooda Game Wizard add-on, or add your own internal functions. With industry standard wheels and screw down feet, Xtreme 3.0 arcade also includes 6 input power board, 3.3V 12A , 5V 20A, 12V 9A power supply, separate 12V power supply, 2x 12volt fans, and EMI filter. WIRING: The cabinet is designed with Jamma wiring system. The machine also supports JVS wiring system (optional) and Game Wizard (optional). CONTROL PANEL: comes as standard arcade 2 player, 6 buttons per side. However the panel is upgradeable, where you can remove metal holders and make this as a 8 button per player control panel, or, fully Arcooda featured with the Game Wizard options (home, back, start extra buttons per player). The following optional add-ons are available directly from Arcooda; - Game Wizard Add-On: includes the Highway I/O board allowing almost all current consoles, PCs, Raspberry Pi, Android and more to be played inside the Xtreme, all just plug and play - no additional adapters needed. And choice of front panel frames (control panel, or monitor panel support). - JVS Arcade Add-On: includes the JVS I/O board allowing modern USB controller games to be used in arcade machines. Includes wiring harnesses. - Arcooda Rear Multimedia Add-On: turn your cabinet into a media centre, with HDMI, USB and RJ45 input/output function. Connect your cabinet to your gaming hub, stream your gameplay on secondary monitors and much more. - Custom Artwork: add your own designs to the game header, acrylic plastics and control panel overlay. Full flexibility is available, you can even put your own face on the control panel! Disclaimer: All product and company names are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective holders. Use of them does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by them. On Screen Images are for demonstration purposes only. GameBoard is not included with the purchase of this machine
